validation_queries.description: A 2 second trace-period delay is only reachable on the cputime clock. transpose 2 100 50 runs for roughly 1.5 seconds of realtime but burns about 5 seconds of process CPU time across its threads, so the window opens and records kernels on cputime and never opens on the realtime default
validation_queries.error_message: No kernels captured. A 2 second delay on the cputime clock should open well before the run ends; zero kernels means the delay was measured against realtime, i.e. ROCPROFSYS_TRACE_PERIOD_CLOCK_ID did not take effect
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM kernels
